method: Deterministic integration audit, not a new equity trial or accuracy estimate. Independently built unmodified GNUbg 1.08.003, same neural/bearoff/MET data; Jacoby money, ordinary cube, pruning on, zero noise. All 21 immediate next rolls after each double-hit continuation, plus the original 44 decision at 0/2/3 ply. Compare up to five CLI finalists at the requested depth, including outcome probabilities; root filters are disabled so every reported move uses that depth and cube-efficiency context; validate parsed move boards against the full legal set. CLI starts fresh per position. The shipped scalar WASM uses its ordinary cache. This does not validate all later game decisions or XG agreement.
